title: Quinn Asks for the Slow Tune
youtube_title: Quinn Asks for the Slow Tune | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a polite voice that helps everyone keep a comfortable pace.
summary: Quinn notices the musicians' walking tune is quicker than Nana's easy pace. Quinn gathers a breath and kindly asks them to play the slower song so the lantern walk can stay together.
